description: Creates, updates, and/or deletes a batch of Units of Measure (UOMs) for the company in a single call. Each entry in `updates` is treated as a create when `id` is omitted, or as an update when `id` is supplied. IDs in `deletes` remove the matching UOMs; standard (Procore-provided) UOMs cannot be deleted via this endpoint and will be reported in the response `errors` array. Only company admins can call this endpoint. See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

items.description: A Unit of Measure (UOM) configured for the company. UOMs are scoped to a `uom_category` and may be Procore-provided standards or company-defined custom units.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the Unit of Measure. Use as the `{id}` path parameter on `GET`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uoms/{id}`.

is_standard.description: True when this UOM is one of Procore's built-in standard units (e.g., `hours`, `sf`, `ls`); standard UOMs cannot be deleted, and only `name` can be modified. False for company-defined custom UOMs.

name.description: Display name of the UOM (e.g., `hours`, `sf`, `ls`). Returned localized for the requesting user. Unique per company.

description.description: Human-readable label for the UOM (e.g., `Lump Sum`). Present and localized only for Procore standard UOMs; null for company-defined custom UOMs.

uom_category.description: The UOM Category this UOM belongs to.

items.description: A single failed entry returned by `PATCH /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uoms/sync`. Contains the original UOM payload alongside an `errors` map keyed by field name explaining why the row failed ...

updates.description: UOMs to create or update. Omit `id` to create a new custom UOM; supply `id` to update an existing UOM. For Procore-provided standard UOMs, only `name` can be updated; `uom_category_id` changes are ...

id.description: ID of an existing Unit of Measure to update. Omit when creating a new UOM.

name.description: Display name of the UOM (e.g., `hours`, `sf`). Required when creating; optional on updates. Must be unique within the company and cannot match a Procore standard UOM name.

uom_category_id.description: ID of the parent UOM Category from `GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uom_categories`. Required when creating; optional on updates.

deletes.description: IDs of custom UOMs to delete. Standard (Procore-provided) UOMs cannot be deleted via this endpoint and will be reported in the response `errors` array.

items.description: ID of a custom Unit of Measure to delete.
